intro: Small Python authoring API. Use request for HTTP data, context for helpers/shared state, and input for the previous node output.

groups.title: Functions you write
groups.summary: Fixed function names. Keep the signatures as shown.

entries.name: run(input, request, context, params)
entries.summary: Custom node body. Return the value for the next step.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Runs once when a request reaches this node.

details.label: Input
details.text: input is the previous node output or None. request is the HTTP request. context has state/log/notify helpers. params are this node's configured values.

details.label: Output
details.text: Any value. The next node/operator receives it as input.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: May update context.state, log, notify, redirect the request, or block it.

entries.name: triggered_by(request)
entries.summary: Start node gate. Return True to run the policy.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Runs before the policy starts.

details.label: Input
details.text: Only request. No context and no previous input.

details.label: Output
details.text: True routes to next. False skips the policy.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: None. Keep it a pure request check.

entries.name: if_condition(input)
entries.summary: If operator. Choose then or else.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Routes an If operator.

details.label: Input
details.text: Only input, the previous node output.

details.label: Output
details.text: True routes to then. False routes to else.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: None. Operators only choose a route.

entries.name: switch_condition(input)
entries.summary: Switch operator. Return the output case label.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Routes a Switch operator.

details.label: Input
details.text: Only input, the previous node output.

details.label: Output
details.text: Case label string. If no route matches, default is used when present.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: None. Operators only choose a route.

groups.title: request
groups.summary: Current HTTP request. Read it, redirect it, or block it.

entries.name: request.method
entries.summary: HTTP method such as GET or POST.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Read-only request metadata.

details.label: Output
details.text: String method, or empty string if unavailable.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Use for platform/domain matching.

details.label: Output
details.text: String host without the scheme.

entries.name: request.url
entries.summary: Full URL. Assigning redirects the request.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Read the full URL or assign a new URL.

details.label: Output
details.text: String URL.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: Setting request.url changes the outbound request target.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Use for path-based rules.

details.label: Output
details.text: String path, often starting with /.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Read request headers by name.

details.label: Output
details.text: Header mapping.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Use only when body content matters.

details.label: Output
details.text: Decoded text. Returns empty string if unavailable.

entries.name: request.redirect(url)
entries.summary: Redirect the outbound request to another URL.

details.label: Input
details.text: url: target URL string.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: Changes the request URL.

entries.name: request.block(status, message)
entries.summary: Stop the request and return a plain-text response.

details.label: Input
details.text: status: HTTP status code. message: plain-text response body.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: Sets the response and stops the policy mode after this step.

groups.title: context
groups.summary: Helpers shared by nodes: state, logging, notifications.

details.label: Contract
details.text: Use it to share mutable data structures between nodes and requests handled by the same evaluator.

details.label: Input
details.text: key: string.

details.label: Output
details.text: The stored value. Values are kept by reference, so mutating a stored dict/list is visible to later nodes.

entries.name: context.state.get(key, default)
entries.summary: Read state safely with a default.

details.label: Input
details.text: key: string. default: returned when key is missing.

details.label: Output
details.text: Stored value or default.

entries.name: context.state.setdefault(key, value)
entries.summary: Create shared state once and return it.

details.label: Input
details.text: key: string. value: initial value when missing.

details.label: Output
details.text: Existing or newly stored value.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: Adds value to context.state if key was missing.

entries.name: context.log(type, message, level, **data)
entries.summary: Write a structured event to Observability.

details.label: Input
details.text: type: event type. message: human text. level defaults to info. **data is structured metadata.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: Appends one event to the event log.

entries.name: context.notify(type, message, level, **data)
entries.summary: Send a UI notification and log it.

details.label: Input
details.text: type: notification title/type. message: body. level defaults to info. **data is structured metadata.

details.label: Side effects
details.text: Appends a notification event. The UI shows it as a native notification when enabled.

groups.title: params
groups.summary: Configured values for the current node.

entries.name: params[key]
entries.summary: Read a node parameter configured in the UI.

details.label: Input
details.text: key: parameter name.

details.label: Output
details.text: Configured value.

details.label: Raises
details.text: KeyError if the parameter is missing.
